new_sources.title: Open Interest
new_sources.author: SeaScalper-Farouk (WR)
teaching_claims: Open Interest = number of open contracts; combine with price direction
operational_rules: Price DOWN + OI UP = more shorts opened = bearish
Price UP + OI UP = more longs opened = bullish
new_sources.state_machine_relevance: an ADDITIONAL data input (OI); out of current SMC scope
